name: Trigenys Claude Accounts Manager
description: Windows app to run several Claude subscriptions side by side: isolated profiles, official quota tracking, reset and usage alerts.
brief: Manage several Claude accounts on one Windows PC: isolated Claude Code profiles (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) and Desktop data dirs, private-window login, official 5-hour and 7-day quotas read through the CLI control protocol without ever reading login tokens, renewal dates, account recommendation, reset notifications, usage threshold and pace alerts, and a notification-area icon.
